SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow managed apparel
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow apparel required by an Automatic Outfit Manager rule, retained as managed locker stock, or protected as an exact managed or saved item. Removing or clearing a requirement keeps the apparel type managed; use Forget in Choose apparel when unused stock should return to ordinary storage.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow non-managed apparel
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow ordinary apparel that is not required by a rule, retained as managed locker stock, or protected as an exact managed or saved item by Automatic Outfit Manager.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow managed weapons
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow primary weapons selected by an Automatic Outfit Manager rule, retained as managed locker stock, or protected as an exact managed or saved weapon. Removing or clearing a requirement keeps the weapon type managed; use Forget in Choose weapons when unused stock should return to ordinary storage.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow non-managed weapons
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow ordinary weapons that are not selected by a rule, retained as managed locker stock, or protected as an exact managed or saved weapon by Automatic Outfit Manager.
